title: Renewal Tire Bundle — Alignment Services & Plans Month-Based Plans
content:
On the renewal of an expired Alignment Services & Plans month-based plan, a renewal tire bundle is taken off the renewal price according to the install date of the vehicle's active Crestline tire set under Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty, counted in calendar days before the renewal date:

| Vehicle's active Crestline tire set installed | Renewal tire bundle |
|---|---|
| no more than 30 calendar days before the renewal date (the renewal date included) | the line's tire bundle discount: 20.00 on the Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan, 30.00 on the Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan |
| more than 30 but no more than 60 calendar days before it | 15.00 |
| earlier, or the vehicle has no active Crestline tire set | 0.00 |

The bundle is worked out on its own and taken off the renewal price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical, 3-Year line):** a set installed 30 days before the renewal → 30.00; 31 days before → 15.00; 60 days before → 15.00; 61 days before → 0.00.
